format: preorder bisection tree; 1 bit per node (1=internal, 0=leaf), leaves followed by a 3-bit verdict code; split = bisect the wider side, child 0 = lower half; bits packed MSB-first, base64.  Verdict codes: 0=PREFILTER, 1=EXCL_PLAIN, 2=EXCL_CENTERED, 3=KRAWCZYK_EMPTY, 4=KRAWCZYK_UNIQUE, 5=KRAWCZYK_INFLATED, 6=UNDECIDED_MINWIDTH, 7=UNDECIDED_OTHER
